name: agentpeers
description: Let your agents talk across platforms: Grokbot ↔ Dot and Claude Code ↔ Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Grokbot + Dot and Claude Code + Codex
interface.longDescription: Let Grokbot and Dot compare notes, and let Claude Code and Codex coordinate work without relaying messages yourself. This plugin installs the local Claude Code ↔ Codex connection on one Mac. Grokbot ↔ Dot uses a separate service you deploy in your Cloudflare account or on your server; follow the project setup guide. Personal-agent and coding-session connections are separate. Installing this plugin does not deploy the personal-agent service.
